data.Q: Whom do the sons tell about the man of God's words to the king?
Who asks about the way the man of God went?
For whom do the sons saddle the donkey?
Who rides after the man of God?
What does the old prophet do just before he asks the man of God?
data.A: The old prophet finds the man of God sitting under an oak tree.
data.wrong_answer: The old prophet mounts the donkey.

data.Q: Why do the sons show their father a road?
data.A: Because their father asks which way the man of God went.
data.wrong_answer: Because the man of God spoke to the king.
